kind: web widgets and code snippets: drop-in snippets (cookie notice, store locator, donations, contact button) you paste into a site, no coding needed
why: target picked by the build queue: a small, embeddable, no-code widget collection, the kind of thing a site owner drops in by pasting a snippet. Void's notch is widgets that are alive on the stage and talk to the rest of the site, not static snippets.
rule: Elevenessee: the target's feature is the floor, not the blueprint. Void never ships its copy of X; it ships X plus one notch, and the plus one is written down before the build starts.

features.theirs: a cookie consent notice widget you paste in, customizable without coding
features.plus_one: a consent notice that reads the site's own cookies and explains each one in plain words, and remembers the choice per visitor without a third-party script
